negative-offset-fix.name: Enable Negative Offset Workaround
negative-offset-fix.description: Automatically use workaround for the bug with negative offset

padded-cache-path.name: Negative Offset Audio Cache
padded-cache-path.description: Custom directory for storing padded audio cache files for the negative offset workaround. Leave empty to use the mod's save directory

padded-cache-max-size.name: Max Audio Cache Size (MB)
padded-cache-max-size.description:
Maximum disk space to use for the negative offset audio cache. Oldest files are deleted when exceeded.
-1 = unlimited, 0 = only current level

clear-cache.name: Clear Audio Cache
clear-cache.description: Delete all cached padded audio files used for the negative offset workaround. Files will be regenerated when needed.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Enable detailed offset-related logging for debugging

debug-beep-in-padding.name: Debug: Beep in Padding
debug-beep-in-padding.description: Add periodic beep tones to verify the negative offset audio is being used. Each beep = 100ms, every 500ms
